rationale: Skyway Concession Company LLC is the one current concessionaire PortCo. Atlas Arteria acquired CPP Investments' and OMERS' 33.33% interests and closed on 2022-12-01, while Ontario Teachers' retained 33.33%. The June 2026 potential sale was paused, the OTPP put settlement changed contractual rights rather than equity ownership, and IFM's Atlas transaction was upstream.
recommendedChanges: Retain Ontario Teachers' active 33.33% ownership from 2016.
Add Atlas Arteria active 66.67% ownership from 2022-12-01.
Retire CPP Investments and OMERS ownership periods on 2022-12-01.
Preserve Ferrovial/Cintra and Macquarie historical periods.
Do not add PSP or treat holdcos, the City or the road itself as separate PortCos.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact OTPP CCPI holder is not publicly disclosed.
Exact 2006 MIP transfer close is not publicly disclosed.
